processes.tagg_sitara_deal_linking_enforcement: Reminding schedulers/bookers to cross-link Sitara, Tagg, SCI and EOL deal numbers and mark deals correctly so downstream accounting and credit are not broken.
processes.trading_book_setup_access: Setting up or mapping trading books, pipes, zones, trader access and user lists in Sitara/Tagg on request, and confirming completion.
processes.booked_deal_reconciliation_valuation: Reconciling deals booked in Tagg/Sitara against counterparty or desk lists so they can be valued and positions calculated for the P&L.
processes.deal_price_calculation_support: Calculating or correcting contract prices in Sitara and sending calc sheets or settle prices to settlements staff who dispute or redraft invoices.
processes.daily_pnl_position_review: Reviewing and confirming draft daily P&L and position reports or gathering P&L inputs for the desk.
